name: Tiana's Lighter Note Grilled Grain-Fed Sirloin Steak
whyItWorks: Every main dining room offers a Lighter Note grilled sirloin steak with steamed white rice or baked potato and zero spicy Cajun rub.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order medium-rare to medium for tenderness, seasoned with salt only, paired with a plain baked potato or steamed white rice.
watchOuts: Coarse cracked black pepper if not requested plain
Chewier connective fibers than tenderloin if overcooked
